name: Voyageur
description: Architecte de la Neutralité orchestrant l'équilibre des rapports de force entre factions pour empêcher l'hégémonie totale.

loadout.armor_outfit: Vêtements usés par le voyage, tons gris-brun, équipement de fortune. Visages marqués par les vents stellaires. Regard perçant., one-of-a-kind materials
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's growing ability (all_own) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Transcendent manifestation — character as the ultimate embodiment of their entire faction's philosophy and power — Radiating web of light connecting to all allied positions across the board
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — cosmic significance visible in every feature

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Dusty Steel Gray
palette_names.role: primary_accent — weathered clothing and armor base

palette_names.name: Warm Amber
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — lantern light, eye highlights, tool glints

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Celestial multi-layered lighting: divine light from above, energy emanation from below, inner glow from character's own power, environmental reflections on a cosmic scale

camera.angle: dutch angle with multi-plane depth of field emphasizing cosmic significance and otherworldly presence

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation at the edge of known space, corrugated metal walls scarred by micrometeorite impacts, flickering plasma lanterns casting long shadows on rusted bulkheads
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Fine stellar dust floating in dim light, distant nebula glow through cracked observation windows, scattered debris suggesting transience, plus network effect — luminous web spanning the battlefield connecting all teammates visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Architecte de la Neutralité orchestrant l'équilibre des rapports de force entre factions pour empêcher l'hégémonie totale.

card_metadata.composition_directive: Epic cinematic wide-angle showing the character reshaping reality around them, with scale suggesting world-changing impact
